macheteDetails.name: Machete
macheteDetails.desc: A heavier blade for F: 2.45m reach and 69 damage (knife: 2.4m, 26). Narrower swing, up to 3 targets, slightly quicker recovery.

upgradesRows.name: Field Intel
upgradesRows.desc: See every enemy type, count and approach at the HQ panel.

upgradesRows.name: Machete

upgradesRows.name: Pistol pair
upgradesRows.desc: A second Pistol for the off hand. Y switches between one and two: twice the rate of fire and twice the loaded rounds, for a wider group, a slower reload, and no hand free for a grenade or the blade.

upgradesRows.name: Pistol extended mag
upgradesRows.desc: Magazine 12 → 18, and a bigger reserve to match.

upgradesRows.name: Pistol suppressor
upgradesRows.desc: A can on the muzzle: quieter, a little less punch.

upgradesRows.name: Pistol auto sear
upgradesRows.desc: Enables full auto. Climbs harder than the Wasp SMG. X switches SEMI / AUTO outside build mode.

chainsawDetails.name: Chainsaw
chainsawDetails.desc: No ammo, just gas. Hold to cut.
